title: 2027 Audit Graduate Programme - Dublin
description: **Graduate Programme 2027 – Audit** Real Opportunities with Grant Thornton's Graduate Programme. **About Grant Thornton** Grant Thornton is one of Ireland's leading professional services firms, with nearly 3,000 people and a global network spanning more than 145 countries. We combine local expertise with international insight to help clients solve complex challenges and achieve sustainable growth. **Audit** **About the Team** Grant Thornton's Audit practice provides independent assurance services to organisations across a wide range of industries, helping stakeholders make informed business decisions with confidence. Our professionals combine technical expertise, commercial understanding and industry knowledge to deliver high\-quality audits that go beyond compliance. The Audit practice comprises **Corporate Audit, Financial Services (FS) Audit and Global Statutory Audit** teams, providing graduates with exposure to a diverse range of industries, organisations and audit environments. **Corporate Audit** works with clients ranging from large multinational corporations and listed entities to privately owned businesses and rapidly growing entrepreneurial companies. **Financial Services (FS) Audit** supports a broad range of regulated entities, including investment funds, asset managers, aircraft leasing companies, banking institutions and insurance businesses. **Global Statutory Audit** works with multinational organisations to coordinate statutory audit requirements across multiple jurisdictions, collaborating with Grant Thornton member firms around the world to deliver seamless and consistent audit services. Our professionals support clients across a variety of sectors, including: * Technology * Financial Services * Aviation and Leasing * Manufacturing * Healthcare and Life Sciences * Retail and Consumer Business * Real Estate and Construction Energy and Infrastructure * As an Audit Graduate, you'll gain hands\-on experience from day one, working with a diverse portfolio of clients and developing a deep understanding of how businesses operate. You'll have the opportunity to build strong technical accounting and auditing knowledge while gaining valuable insight into the financial and operational drivers behind business performance. Whether working with large multinational organisations, indigenous Irish businesses, high\-growth companies or public interest entities, you'll contribute to engagements that help build trust and confidence in financial reporting. **What You Will Do** As a Graduate Trainee within Audit, you'll work closely with experienced auditors and client teams on a variety of audit and assurance engagements across Corporate Audit, FS Audit and Global Statutory Audit. You may have the opportunity to: * Assist in planning and executing financial statement audits. * Review financial records, business processes and internal controls. * Analyse financial data and assess audit risks. * Prepare audit working papers and supporting documentation. * Perform substantive testing across key financial statement areas. * Participate in stock counts and other audit procedures. * Support the identification and assessment of control weaknesses and business risks. * Work directly with clients to gather information and understand their operations. * Prepare reports, presentations and client deliverables. Collaborate with colleagues across Audit, Tax and Advisory teams. * **The Experience You Will Gain** You'll gain practical experience working with businesses of varying sizes and complexities while developing a strong understanding of accounting standards, regulatory requirements and audit methodology. **How We Will Support Your Development** At Grant Thornton, we are committed to helping our people realise their potential. As an Audit Graduate, you'll benefit from: * Structured learning and development programmes. * Professional qualification support through ACA training. * Dedicated mentoring and coaching. * Technical accounting and audit training. * Study leave and exam support. * Opportunities to work directly with senior stakeholders and client management teams. * Access to The Academy training programme. Clear pathways for long\-term career progression and leadership development. * Our culture encourages curiosity, innovation and continuous improvement, giving graduates the support and opportunities needed to build successful careers in professional services. **Who We're Looking For** We welcome applications from graduates across a broad range of disciplines who are interested in business, finance and professional services. Successful candidates will demonstrate: * Strong IT, analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. * Attention to detail and a commitment to quality. * Curiosity about how businesses operate. * A proactive and collaborative mindset. * Strong organisational and time management skills. * The ability to analyse information critically and think commercially. A minimum 2\.1 degree, or expected equivalent, in any discipline. * **It would also be helpful if you have** * Experience gained through an internship, part\-time role, volunteering, university society or team\-based project. An interest in how organisations change, improve services or make better use of technology * **Join Us** Join Grant Thornton's Audit team and gain exposure to some of Ireland's most dynamic organisations across Corporate Audit, Financial Services Audit and Global Statutory Audit. You'll develop technical expertise, commercial insight and professional skills while helping businesses maintain transparency, accountability and trust. **Location and working arrangement:** Dublin office, primarily office\-based. **Application and selection process:** Apply through link \- complete our application form and upload your current CV. Closing date Thursday 22 October 2026\. Selection process early November 2026\. Start date Autumn 2027\. **Real Opportunities with Grant Thornton's Graduate Programme.** \#LI\-KS1

title: AI Builder, Emerging Talent - French Market
description: *To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.* **About Futureforce University Recruiting** Our Futureforce University Recruiting program is dedicated to attracting, retaining and cultivating talent. Our interns and new graduates work on real projects that affect how our business runs, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of our company. With offices all over the world, our recruits have the chance to collaborate and connect with fellow employees on a global scale. We offer job shadowing, mentorship programs, talent development courses, and much more. **Job Category** Software Engineering **Job Details** **About Salesforce** Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. **AI Builder, Emerging Talent \- French Market** Technical foundation required. Builder mindset non\-negotiable. Salesforce is hiring AI Builders, people who are early in their career but not early in their ambition. As part of our first\-of\-its\-kind **AI Builder New Grad cohort** , you'll be embedded directly with customer\-facing teams, designing, developing, and deploying **Agentic solutions** for the world’s Fortune 500\. We are at the beginning of the agentic era, and you will be at the keyboard building the solutions that define how the world's largest companies operate. You’ll deliver real\-time customer impact from day one. Working in a builder pod, a cross\-functional team that collaborates to design, build, and deploy AI solutions for real customers. It's a built\-in support system to ensure you're set up to win. Honestly, you're already thinking about what you'd build here… **The AI Builder Experience** * AI\-Powered Development: You'll be developing real customer solutions with the best\-in\-class suite of leading\-edge AI tools: Including Cursor, Claude, and our coding products like Vibes, to accelerate development. * Dedicated Mentorship: You won’t be building in a vacuum. You’ll be part of a program focused on hands\-on technical skill development, shadowing opportunities, and meaningful networking. You’ll be paired with a dedicated onboarding buddy and have the opportunity to partner with senior developers. * Skill Acceleration: This role is designed to develop both your technical depth and your sales skills, ensuring you can lead high\-level conversations with stakeholders. **What You'll Actually Be Building** * Develop AI agents that take real actions for real companies. This is not a side project. Agentforce is live, in production, running for some of the biggest companies on the planet. * Design Agent Intelligence: Design how agents think: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and the entire architecture, leveraging AI/LLM technologies and the Agentforce platform. * Support the entire Technical Lifecycle: Collaborate with other Builders to architect, build, debug, and deploy high\-quality, scalable production systems using JavaScript, Python, and Apex. * Drive Strategic Impact: Partner with clients to turn business challenges into agentic solutions. You’ll use your consultative skills to ensure our tech meets real\-world needs * Iterate and Deploy: Test it, break it, fix it, ship it. Repeat. You will own your work from day one. **You’re Our Builder If…** * You have a strong background in Computer Science or a related engineering discipline. * You’re an AI native who has been deep in LLMs and prompt engineering. * You are fluent in React, TypeScript, GraphQL, Python, OOP and Real\-Time Infra * You can hold your own in a room with our sales teams and customers. * You write high\-quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor. * You thrive in the group chat that’s building something, not just talking about it. * You're ready to grow faster here than anywhere else \- nobody has 10 years of experience in this new frontier, which means your ideas carry real weight from day one. * You bring sharp problem\-solving instincts, relentless initiative, and a get\-things\-done mentality. * You are excited to travel 25\-50% of the time, working directly alongside our customers to see your code come to life in their environments. * Fluency required in French and English Unleash Your Potential When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. Accommodations If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form. Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options. ********Posting Statement******** Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non\-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Air & Emissions Technician
description: **Company Description** **About Environment \& Safety** SOCOTEC’s Environment and Safety team provides expert environmental, health and safety consultancy and compliance services that help organisations manage risk, protect people and safeguard the environment. Our services include environmental monitoring and consultancy, water safety and hygiene solutions with Legionella risk assessments and water system management, fire safety consultancy and inspections, occupational hygiene assessments and workplace exposure monitoring, and specialist advisory support on regulatory and sustainability challenges. We use industry\-leading tools and science\-based approaches to deliver accurate data, practical guidance and innovative solutions that ensure compliance with UK legislation, minimise environmental impact and create healthier, safer workplaces for clients **What's in it for you?** Your expertise deserves recognition. Alongside a competitive salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package including 25 days holiday (with the option to buy more), an electric car scheme (where applicable), employee recognition programmes, family\-friendly support, exclusive retail discounts, employee assistance programmes, and an enhanced company pension. SOCOTEC UK \& Ireland are proud to be Disability Confident accredited. **Job Description** **Emissions Monitoring Technician** **Ideally located within a commutable distance to Naas.** Are you interested in industrial emissions testing? This could be your opportunity to excel as an Emissions Monitoring Technician, playing a vital role in supporting SOCOTEC’s continued success. As SOCOTEC grows, so do our teams. We’re looking for a dedicated Emissions Monitoring Technician to join our Environment \& Safety – Air \& Emissions division and wear the SOCOTEC badge with pride. We are seeking a proactive, reliable, and flexible Emissions Monitoring Technician to join our Environment \& Safety team. In this role, you’ll need the confidence to support MCERTS and UKAS\-accredited emissions testing activities while working safely on client sites. An interest in environmental monitoring is essential to thrive in this position. The tasks you will undertake will include (but are not limited to): * Delivering accurate, technically competent emissions testing and reporting services to a wide range of clients * Working safely at all times, following the company’s Integrated Management System policies and procedures * Supporting the Team Leader with the maintenance, servicing, and UKAS\-traceable calibration of specialist emissions monitoring equipment in line with ISO 17025 standards * Assisting with on\-site MCERTS \& UKAS\-accredited emissions testing activities at industrial facilities and regulated client sites * Conducting site\-specific risk assessments following training, ensuring safe and compliant operations * Working both independently and collaboratively to achieve company and client performance targets and KPIs **Qualifications** To be a successful Emissions Monitoring Technician, you should be able to demonstrate: * Ideally a scientific or similar background * Full driving licence * General awareness of Environmental Legislation and the requirement for industrial emissions testing * Ability to work well under pressure with a focus on deadlines * Be comfortable working at heights * Proficient IT skills – particularly Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft software Additional Information **Why SOCOTEC?** Join a thriving community of over 2,000 industry professionals who are passionate about making a real difference. At SOCOTEC UK, we're not just delivering services \- we're shaping the future of testing, inspection, and certification across the nation. What sets us apart? Our people. We've built our reputation on attracting exceptional talent like you and empowering them to deliver excellence at every turn. Our comprehensive range of TIC services means you'll have the opportunity to work on diverse, challenging projects that truly matter. In this role, you won't just be another employee \- you'll be a key player in our continued success story. Your expertise will directly contribute to our mission of building a safer, more sustainable world, while you grow your career alongside some of the industry's finest professionals. **Your Career, Your Way** Build a traditional career path or explore opportunities across multiple disciplines \- all within SOCOTEC. Your choice, your direction. **Work Your Way** Local, national, or global projects. Office\-based, remote, or hybrid. We offer the flexibility that empowers you to perform at your best. **Committed to Your Growth** From day one, you'll have access to comprehensive training, mentorship, and development programs. We support every step of your professional journey. \#YouGrowWeGrow Think you've got what it takes to add value to our success? We would love to hear from you and look forward to receiving your application. Building a safer and more sustainable world is the core mission we set out to achieve at SOCOTEC, it is at the heart of everything that we do. We are committed to acting as a key player in society, investing in innovative solutions to ensure social and environmental concerns are at the forefront of all of our business operations.

title: Architectural Graduate
description: **Company Description** JFOC Architects is a design\-led practice specialising in housing. The office has a research\-based ethos with an interest in how low\-cost housing can be carefully designed to provide excellent public realm and a strong sense of place. JFOC has helped deliver over 9,000 dwellings since 1987\. Dominic Stevens Architects, an award winning practice, merged with JFOC Architects in 2016 and this has led to the greater focus on research within the office. This research has led to the development of new housing typologies which are now under construction. **Role Description** A Talented Architectural Graduate with an interest in working on Live construction projects is required by JFOC Architects for its practice in Harold’s Cross. This role will allow you to work on projects from planning consent stage through to construction and completion. **Ideal candidate will have:** \- 2 years \+ post graduate experience \- Have experience working on tender / construction stages in Ireland \- Knowledge of Irish building regulations \- Proficient in AutoCAD and Sketchup \- Knowledge of Revit and 3D rendering beneficial. \- Strong Communication and organization skills **What we offer:** JFOC Architects has a fully transparent salary scale which will be provided to candidates following an interview. Career progression and professional development is encouraged and fully supported by the practice. A supportive office environment and work\-life balance are central to the practice ethos. The standard office hours are 9am to 6pm from Monday to Thursday and from 9am to 1pm on Fridays. Excellent terms and conditions, dependent on skills and experience, offering strong career development opportunities within a strong and supportive architectural team. **How to apply:** Apply via to our email address info@jfocarchitects.com. Please include CV and your Portfolio. *JFOC Architects is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring on the basis of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.* Pay: Up to €40,000\.00 per year Benefits: * On\-site parking Work Location: In person

title: Associate Representative - Inside Sales
description: **Job Description** As an Associate Representative \- Inside Sales, you will interact with existing customers, primarily by phone and email, to increase sales of the Company's products and/or services by obtaining and up\-selling orders, creating customer satisfaction and adding value to the customer's buying experience. You will collaborate with outside sales to ensure goals are being met. **Responsibilities** * Obtain orders through email and telephone calls, verifies and enters items, transfers orders to fulfillment, explains stock\-outs and expected delivery dates. * Increase orders by suggesting related items, explaining features, and checks customer’s buying history. * With guidance, owns, qualifies and develops opportunities passed from marketing, outside sales, and national accounts. * Prepare, generate, and follow up on verbal or written quotations to secure orders, or determine reason for loss of order. * Review open customer order reports and act on open items, including those items that may be at risk in meeting customer’s promised delivery date. * Maintain distribution system backorder report, associated customer expediting report and notices, and customer notification. * Report industry trends, competitive pricing and customer feedback to management. **Qualifications** * High School Degree or Equivalent required; Bachelor’s degree preferred. * Preferred knowledge and experience in sales and sales administration; still acquiring higher level knowledge and skills, however still a productive professional contributor (0\-2 years). * Familiar with Microsoft Office, and ability to perform basic computer skills * Ability to perform multiple tasks simultaneously * Ability to work in a team environment * Ability to communicate clearly, both verbally and in written form * Attention to detail * Ability to prospect and market concepts to existing and potentially new accounts * Ability to act and solve routine or standard problems * Ability to identify and define problems and possible solutions independently; chooses among existing solutions * Ability to work independently with supervision * Ability to travel up to 25% **About The Team** At Wesco, we build, connect, power and protect the world. As a leading provider of business\-to\-business distribution, logistics services and supply chain solutions, we create a world that you can depend on. Our Company’s greatest asset is our people. Wesco is committed to fostering a workplace where every individual is respected, valued, and empowered to succeed. We promote a culture that is grounded in teamwork and respect. With a workforce of over 20,000 people worldwide, we embrace the unique perspectives each person brings. Through comprehensive benefits and active community engagement, we create an environment where every team member has the opportunity to thrive. Learn more about Working at Wesco here and apply online today! Founded in 1922 and headquartered in Pittsburgh, Wesco is a publicly traded (NYSE: WCC) FORTUNE 500® company. *Wesco International, Inc., including its subsidiaries and affiliates (“Wesco”) provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, religion, color, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, or other characteristics protected by law. US applicants only, we are an Equal Opportunity Employer.* *Los Angeles Unincorporated County Candidates Only: Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act.* *This posting is for a current, active vacancy intended for immediate hire.*

title: Barback
description: Since 2006, Hawksmoor has been the UK’s home of ethically sourced, grass\-fed beef, cooked over charcoal and paired with award\-winning wines and cocktails. Hawksmoor Dublin plays a key role in bringing our warm, generous hospitality to the city. We’re proud to be a certified B Corp, one of the most sustainable restaurant groups in the industry, and to have been recognised as one of the Best Companies to work for year after year. As a **Barback** at Hawksmoor, you’ll be at the heart of the bar operation. This is a practical, fast\-paced role where you’ll support the bartenders throughout service, helping keep the bar stocked, organised and running smoothly. You’ll play a key part in delivering great drinks and the warm, generous hospitality Hawksmoor is known for. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys being busy, takes pride in doing things properly and wants to build a career in hospitality. **What You’ll Do** * Support the bar team during service by keeping stations stocked, clean and organised * Prepare garnishes, glassware and bar stations to Hawksmoor standards * Keep bar and back\-of\-house areas clean, safe and efficient * Anticipate what the team needs during busy services and act quickly * Work closely with bartenders and floor teams to support smooth service * Learn our drinks, systems and standards, with clear opportunities to progress **Who You Are** * Positive, hardworking and happy to get stuck in * Enjoy fast\-paced, hands\-on work and being on your feet * A reliable team player who takes pride in supporting others * Previous bar or hospitality experience is helpful but not essential — full training provided * Genuinely interested in hospitality and learning new skills **Our Values** **Welcome Everyone** \- We create warm, inclusive spaces where people feel genuinely welcome. **Work Hard and Be Nice to People** \- We set high standards and treat each other with kindness and respect. **Hit Hawksmoor Standards** \- We care deeply about quality and consistency, every day. **Keep Evolving \-** We stay curious, open to feedback and always looking to improve. **Benefits** * 30 days’ holiday * Tronc paid for every hour you work, including holidays and breaks * 25% Sunday Premium * Referral bonuses from day one * Paid annual volunteer days * A dedicated restaurant welfare budget for healthy snacks, drinks, and extra support during busy times * Free meals while you’re at work * 50% off food in our restaurants for you and your loved ones * HSF Health Plan – helping you look after your health and wellbeing * Access to Perkbox for exclusive discounts and perks * Taxsaver Commuter Ticket Scheme * Cycle to Work Scheme * Huge investment in training and development with qualifications across Wine, H\&S, Food Safety, HR and a five\-stage management development programme, run in partnership with the Watershed Management School We’re building a team that reflects the richness and diversity of the communities we serve. At Hawksmoor, we welcome everyone and believe in creating a workplace where individuality is celebrated, kindness is key and high standards are met together. If this role excites you but you don’t meet every requirement, please apply anyway. You might be exactly who we’re looking for.

title: Business Development Representative
description: **Looking to kickstart an ambitious career in technology sales?** Procore is looking for an outbound Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our high\-performing sales team in Dublin. Our Sales Development organisation is an essential component of our corporate sales model and has helped fuel our incredible EMEA growth for the past several years. As a BDR, you’ll master the fundamentals of B2B sales, develop a deep understanding of the trillion\-dollar construction industry, and showcase how Procore's platform helps improve one of the world’s largest sectors. We pride ourselves on setting impressive goals, supporting each other's professional growth, and having a blast achieving them together. We value an inclusive, collaborative floor culture and are looking for optimistic, highly motivated individuals to join our team immediately. ****What you’ll do:**** * Fuel Our Growth: Source and create high\-quality new business opportunities to expand Procore's footprint across the territory. * Partner 1:1 with a Closer: Partner directly with Account Executives as a strategic pod. Together, you will map out target accounts, plan call strategies, and work toward mutually aligned monthly sales quotas. * Master Outbound Engagement: Engage construction professionals through structured phone, email, and social outreach channels to understand their unique workflow challenges and identify opportunities to solve them. * Own Your Day: Conduct daily high\-volume activities including pre\-call account research, high\-velocity prospecting runs, and consistent follow\-up to nurture long\-term leads. * Operate with Autonomy: Be empowered to operate beyond your core day\-to\-day role; help the team optimize our outbound processes, suggest fresh campaign ideas, and actively contribute to training sessions. * Maintain Elite Tech Hygiene: Manage, track, and maintain accurate lead details, opportunities, and account histories within Salesforce.com. ****What we're looking for:**** * Sales Drive \& Ambition: A clear, long\-term motivation to pursue a high\-growth career in technology and master the fundamentals of corporate software sales. * Resilience and Grit: A proven will to achieve goals—possessing the persistence and positive attitude to stay motivated and push harder when the going gets tough. * Coachability \& Continuous Learning: Self\-aware, reflective, and eager to grow. You digest constructive feedback critically, adapt quickly to overcome challenges, and are excited to master the Procore product certification track. * A Team\-First Mindset: A desire to thrive in a highly collaborative, fast\-paced environment where you win as a collective, celebrate team victories, and lift up the people around you. * Living Our Core Values: A natural alignment with Ownership (taking pride in your patch), Optimism (bringing great energy to the floor), and Openness (communicating transparently, thoughtfully, and with genuine empathy). * Dublin Based: You are ready to join us onsite in our Dublin office to collaborate with the team, soak up the unique culture, and enjoy our famous free lunches! ****To REALLY stand out, you have:**** * 1\+ years of experience in a fast\-paced software, SaaS, or high\-volume customer\-facing sales role. * An entrepreneurial spirit—experience running your own university society, side\-hustle, or independent projects. * Direct exposure to, or a strong interest in, the construction, engineering, or property development ecosystems. * A documented track record of hitting targets, whether in previous sales functions, competitive sports, or academic milestones. * A Bachelor's degree or equivalent life and career experience. ****The Process:**** If your profile looks like a fit, our recruiting team will reach out for a "Coffee Chat" screen. No pressure, no formal case studies yet \- just a chance for us to get to know you and for you to see if Procore is your next home. ***Please Note:* *This is a "Pipeline" posting intended to identify potential candidates for future openings. By applying, you are registering your interest for upcoming roles and not a currently active vacancy. We will review all applications and contact relevant candidates as soon as a new seat launches.*** **Additional Information** **Base Pay Range:** 37,520\.00 \- 51,590\.00 EUR Annual **On Target Earning Range:** 53,600\.00 \- 73,700\.00 EUR Annual This role may also be eligible for Equity Compensation and/or Bonus Incentive Compensation. Procore is committed to offering competitive, fair, and commensurate compensation. Actual compensation will be based on a candidate’s job\-related skills, experience, education or training, and location.

title: Customer Advisor - 36 Hours
description: **Your role in the JoJo story…** Do you dream of a role where you can make meaningful contributions that finish in days well spent? If you're ready to begin a fabulous adventure and you're passionate about retail, we have the perfect role for you! Each JoJo store is unique whether that’s trading over two floors, having a quirky layout or being situated in an interesting place. They have a life of their own. Our Unique Selling Point (USP) in this ever\-changing retail world is the relationship we build with our customers, many of them loyal to our brand and to their local store team. This is where you come in \- you’ll be the face of JoJo providing a fantastic level of customer care and service that we are renowned for and one we pride ourselves in upholding always. You’ll be guiding, informing, and assisting our customers in the correct purchase of our huge range of clothing and products. This could be an expectant parent, an excited grandparent or other friends or family. Our B Corp principles are so important, and every member of our teams will always uphold them. As we move into a digital retail world, offering an Omni\-Channel customer service is expected as this builds on customer loyalty. **A peek into your daily adventures:** * Assisting our customers in many different and sometimes diverse situations, from bra measuring or discussing our maternity wear, to demonstrating a baby carrier to an intrigued parent. * Preparing Omni\-Channel orders. * Liaising with customers in store or via the phone on Omni\-Channel orders. * Using our digital or virtual learning platforms to continuously develop your knowledge and retail skills. * Embracing new product knowledge or learning to increase sales opportunities. * Actively listening to our customers’ needs and working out what the best solution is for them. * Taking pride in keeping your store looking immaculate. ***A typical week would be 4 x 7\.5 and 1 x 6 hour shifts however, flexibility is required in line with store requirements.*** **Skills that make you shine:** * Previous retail, customer service and sales experience * Competent IT skills and excellent systems ability, with an aptitude to pick up new systems quickly. * The ability to learn and retain a high level of product information and be able to communicate this effectively to our customers. * You’ll need a self\-developing mentality and a curiosity to learn new products independently. * We don’t like hard sales techniques, but you’ll need to demonstrate a level of sales ability, which includes active listening skills, empathy, and an understanding of our customers’ needs. * You’ll be working within a small team; therefore, the ability to work harmoniously and respectfully is important. * Working in a retail environment requires a level of flexibility, most of our stores are open 7 days a week. * We like to keep our stores looking tip\-top, so you’ll have a keen eye for detail and play a key role in maintaining our standard. Please note: We will only recruit individuals who are over the school leaver's age. To find out more about the school leaver age for Republic of Ireland\- Please click the following link: Rights of young workers (citizensinformation.ie) **Just to give you a taste of our culture, we’ll be looking for you to:** * Be a brand ambassador, safeguarding our values and ethos. * Demonstrate honesty and respect in every interaction. * Foster collaboration and open, active listening * Take ownership of all aspects of the role. * Proactively finding solutions to problems. * Leading a team. **Perks and Benefits:** * Extra day of annual leave for each year you’re with us, up to 10 additional days. * Is it your birthday? Take it off and celebrate! * Let’s celebrate JoJo doing well – non\-contractual bonus scheme. * Helping plan for the future \- enhanced pension scheme. * Flexible work options. * Enjoy fabulous social events. * Saying thank you – employee recognition programme. * Give back with volunteer days to support our communities. * Prioritise your well\-being with our Health and Wellbeing hub. * We love our products! Enjoy: + 40% off JoJo branded lines + 25% off full\-price NEXT products + 10% off NEXT Beauty products + Up to 10% off most branded products * Embrace an “It’s up to you” learning environment with ongoing training and development opportunities. **Want to know more about JoJo?** We make happy and helpful clothes and products that let children be children – in all their silly, messy, adventurous, noisy, imaginative joy. But we’re not just about selling products; we’re about creating a warm, community\-centric environment for our employees and our customers. From 39 locations across the UK and Ireland and a thriving e\-commerce platform, we offer a meticulously designed collection of children’s clothing, toys, and essentials designed with love and care: always with children at the forefront of our minds. As a B Corp, our commitment goes beyond commerce, we strive for a sustainable future and take pride in our responsibilities to the planet and our communities. At JoJo, every role, every task and every day is an opportunity to support, inspire and contribute to the well\-being of our teams and our customers. We embrace and openly welcome people from different cultures, perspectives, and experiences to create a diverse and enriched environment. We work hard to recruit, develop, and retain the most talented people, regardless of background to make sure we grow our company sustainably and with different cultural influences. By encouraging a diverse and inclusive workforce, we aim to create an environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.

title: Customer Assistant

You will also: * Help our customers and put them at ease; whether that’s listening to find out more about them, answering questions and giving great advice on our fantastic products, recommending items they hadn’t considered or simply offering a basket \- it's the little things that make a difference * Get to know our in\-store offers and schemes and promote them \- the more info we can give our customers, the better. * Help our stores run smoothly \- this could look like ensuring we have the right products displayed on the shop floor, providing a great service on our tills, or helping with our stock in in the stock rooms * Work with other members in the team to provide a great shopping experience, ensuring the store is always clean and presentable to provide a store everyone can be proud of **What You’ll Need To Have** Full training is provided for this role, and we are looking for people who * Excel in a varied environment, working at pace * Communicate and listen effectively * Enjoy working as part of a team, promoting a collaborative team dynamic * Know that the little things make the biggest difference for customer interactions * Desire to be a proud brand ambassador for Boots and help our customers find the best products for them **It would be great if you also have** * Experience providing customer care and delivering great customer service but this is not essential. **Our Benefits** * Pension membership (PRSA) * Partial paid maternity leave * Discretionary annual bonus * Generous employee discounts * Flexible benefits scheme We have a great range of benefits in addition to the above that offer flexibility to suit you \- find out more at **boots.jobs/ireland** . Exclusions may apply, eligible roles only. *Please note, any salary estimates given on third\-party sites are not provided or endorsed by Boots and may not be accurate.* **Why Boots** At Boots, we foster a working environment where consideration and inclusivity help everyone to be themselves and reach their full potential. As the heart of everything we do at Boots, with you, we change for the better. **What's Next** If your application is successful, you'll be invited to an in\-store interview in the next 14 days. Where a role is advertised as full\-time, we are open to discussing part\-time and job share options during the application process. If you require additional support as part of the application and interview process, we are happy to provide **reasonable adjustments** to help you to be at your best.

title: Early Career Cyber Defense Centre Analyst, Officer
description: Job Description Job Description What we do. State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data \& analytics, investment research \& trading and investment management to institutional clients. **Who are we looking for:** State Street seeks to recruit an Early Career Cyber Security Operations Center (SOC) analyst that will assist in the detection, triage, analysis and response to cyber\-attacks. The analyst will join our SOC team which will run a 24/7 coverage, 365 days a year model, with a partner team in the United States. The SOC team is responsible for analyzing events from multiple sources from across a large enterprise network. The SOC will partner with multiple teams in our Irish Cyber Fusion Center including but not limited to Advanced Threat, Cyber Threat Intelligence, Content \& Red/Purple teams. Join us in evolving our response capabilities to protect State Street, its customers and partners from the ever evolving and sophisticated global threat actors. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success. We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work\-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law. title: Event Service Specialist

description: **Company Overview** Throughout our worldwide network of experts, clients and communities, we are renowned for our leadership in fire protection engineering – a legacy of responsibility we have proudly upheld since 1939\. Today, our expertise extends broadly across closely related security and risk\-based fields – from accessibility consulting and risk analysis to process safety, forensic investigations, security risk consulting, emergency management, digital innovation and more. Our employees are our greatest strength, and we value the unique perspectives and talents they bring to our organization. Our wide range of Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organization, supporting career development and providing forums for individuals to share experiences on topics they're passionate about. Together, we are cultivating a connected culture where everyone has the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed together. **Job Overview** These roles are open across all our UK \& I offices, please do not apply to all the vacancies but your preferred location, if you are open to more than one location, we will identify this during the recruitment process. Please note to be considered for this role you must have the right to work in the UK or Ireland. Since 1939, Jensen Hughes has been a company fiercely committed to our purpose, our clients, and each other, every single member of our team is essential to our success. We have a great opportunity for Graduate Fire Engineer to join us across the UK and Ireland and become part of our 1,500\+ global employees who work together to advance the science of safety every day. Why join us to grow your career? * What if I told you 74% of our current Directors/Technical Directors in the UK \& Ireland started their career with us as graduates? Exciting right! * We are the largest fire consultancy in Europe with offices located in Belgium, Finland, Italy, Denmark and the UK \& Ireland. Our reputation for providing innovative, design focused solutions has made us the consultant of choice for many of Europe’s leading property clients. * As a Graduate Fire Engineer, you will be an integral part of a dynamic design team, working with our experienced Engineers you will receive constant technical support to quickly gain knowledge and experience in fire engineering projects. * Working with us offers an exciting range of opportunities to develop your career within a supportive and diverse team who always strive to do the right thing for our people, clients and communities. * You will be given early responsibility and the opportunity to progress rapidly. We’ve successfully welcomed graduate fire engineers from a variety of STEM Master’s backgrounds, including Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace/Aeronautical, and Physics. Many of these individuals have gone on to build outstanding careers with us. If you’re committed to pursuing a career in Fire Engineering and hold a transferable STEM Master’s degree, we’d love to hear from you, tell us why you’re ready to join our team! **Graduate Development Programme** Our Graduate Development Programme gives you hands\-on project work, mentorship, and the support to work toward professional accreditation. As a graduate, you’ll play a role in delivering solutions that protect people while helping to create a more sustainable built environment. **Our People Are Our Greatest Asset** At Jensen Hughes, we know that our people are the foundation of our success. For certain teams, this may include an early Friday finish at 3 pm once contracted hours and client deadlines are met. We also offer: * Flexible working hours and patterns * Flexible holiday use over Christmas/New Year * Enhanced holiday entitlement after three years * The option to carry over up to five unused holiday days into the next year (subject to discussion and approval) **A Commitment to Continuous Improvement** Our benefits represent a meaningful investment in both our people and the future of Jensen Hughes. title: Modelling Resident
description: The Role A modelling residency puts you in the center of a frontier lab. We're looking for builders and creative thinkers ready to shape the next era of intelligence.

title: Student Veterinary Nurse - Weekends only
description: **Student Veterinary Nurse \- Weekends Only** **Anicare Vets \- Glasnevin Veterinary Clinic** **Part\-Time \| Permanent €14\.15 per hour** **Start Building Your Veterinary Career with a Supportive Practice Team** Are you a Student Veterinary Nurse looking to gain valuable experience alongside your studies? At Anicare Vets Glasnevin, we're looking for a motivated, enthusiastic and compassionate individual to join our team in a weekend support role. This is a fantastic opportunity to become part of a friendly, close\-knit veterinary practice where you'll gain exposure to the day\-to\-day running of a busy first opinion small animal clinic while working alongside experienced Veterinary Surgeons, Veterinary Nurses and Receptionists. Anicare Glasnevin offers a welcoming community practice environment where relationships matter. You'll work closely with a team of three Veterinary Surgeons, three to four Veterinary Nurses and an experienced reception team, giving you the opportunity to learn from a variety of professionals while contributing to the care of our patients and clients. **A Role That Fits Around Your Studies** This position is ideal for a Student Veterinary Nurse seeking practical experience while balancing college commitments. The role is based on Saturdays from 9:00am to 5:00pm, providing a regular weekly opportunity to develop your skills within a veterinary practice environment. Additional hours may occasionally be available during study breaks, college holidays and periods of annual leave or sickness cover, offering further opportunities to gain experience and increase your exposure to life in practice. **Build Your Skills In a Busy Veterinary Practice** This is a varied and rewarding support role where no two days are the same. You'll play an important part in helping the clinic run smoothly, supporting both our front\-of\-house and clinical teams while ensuring our patients receive the highest standard of care. Working across different areas of the clinic, you'll help create a positive experience for clients and their pets from the moment they arrive. You'll also assist the nursing team with day\-to\-day non\-clinical patient care, maintain high standards of cleanliness and organisation throughout the practice, and provide practical support wherever it is needed. For students looking to develop a deeper understanding of veterinary practice, this role offers valuable insight into both the clinical and operational aspects of delivering excellent veterinary care. **Learn, Develop And Gain Real Practice Experience** As part of your role, you'll support the reception team in creating a welcoming and professional environment for clients while helping to keep the day running efficiently. You'll gain experience observing the flow of appointments, interacting with clients and understanding the wider patient journey within a veterinary setting. Behind the scenes, you'll work closely with the nursing team by assisting with the preparation and organisation of clinical areas, helping maintain treatment rooms and kennel spaces, and supporting the overall care and wellbeing of patients during their time in the practice. You'll also contribute to maintaining exceptionally high standards of hygiene, infection control and organisation throughout the clinic. The role is designed to provide meaningful exposure to life within a first opinion practice while allowing you to build confidence, develop professional skills and gain experience that complements your veterinary nursing studies. **Who We're Looking For** We're looking for a current Student Veterinary Nurse who is eager to learn, enjoys working with both people and animals, and wants to gain practical experience in a supportive practice environment. The ideal candidate will bring a positive attitude, strong communication skills and a genuine passion for animal welfare. You'll be someone who enjoys being part of a team, takes pride in doing the small things well and is happy to support colleagues wherever needed. Reliability, enthusiasm and a willingness to get involved are just as important as previous experience. While prior exposure to a veterinary or customer\-facing environment would be advantageous, we recognise that every veterinary professional starts somewhere and we are committed to supporting the development of the right individual. **Why Join Anicare Vets Glasnevin?** Anicare Glasnevin is a well\-established first opinion small animal practice with a strong reputation for delivering compassionate, high\-quality veterinary care to the local community. Our team takes pride in creating a supportive and collaborative working environment where everyone contributes to the success of the practice. You'll have the opportunity to work alongside experienced veterinary professionals who are passionate about patient care, committed to maintaining high standards and invested in helping future veterinary nurses develop their skills and confidence. If you're looking for a welcoming practice where you can gain practical experience, learn from a dedicated team and become an important part of everyday clinical life, we'd love to hear from you. **Benefits** We offer a competitive salary and an excellent range of benefits designed to support your wellbeing, development and future career. Our benefits package includes annual leave, birthday leave, paid maternity, paternity, bereavement and sick leave, alongside access to wellbeing initiatives such as our Employee Assistance Programme, Cycle to Work Scheme, retail discounts, free flu vaccinations and company\-wide wellbeing programmes. We're also committed to supporting career growth through structured development opportunities, annual pay reviews, career progression pathways and access to our Leadership Academy. Additional benefits include pension contributions and discounted veterinary fees for your own pets. Benefits are subject to pro\-rata entitlement where applicable. **Ready to Take The Next Step?** This is an excellent opportunity to gain hands\-on experience within a busy, community\-focused veterinary practice while continuing your Veterinary Nursing studies. If you're looking for a role that will help you build confidence, develop practical skills and become part of a friendly and supportive team, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today to join Anicare Vets Glasnevin and take the next step in your veterinary nursing journey. €0 \- €14\.15 an hour €14\.15 per hour We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. title: Team Member, HR Support Centre

In support of ESB’s strategic objectives, this role helps deliver efficient, consistent and customer\-focused people services by supporting employees and pensioners, resolving routine HR queries, enabling self\-service where appropriate, and working with HR colleagues to ensure queries are progressed and resolved effectively. **Key Responsibilities** * Act as the initial point of contact for HR\-related queries and service requests from employees and pensioners, handling email, system and phone queries. * Log all queries using the MSM Marval ticketing system and ensure records are maintained accurately. * Assist with processing HR service requests, including Long Service Awards, Cycle to Work, Medical Benefits Claims and personal information updates. * Resolve general queries Monitor query trends, identify opportunities for process or information improvement, and support the ongoing update of knowledge repositories and job aids. **Essential** **Experience and Qualifications** * A minimum of 1–2 years’ relevant work experience. * Strong customer service skills, including call or query handling experience. * Ability to provide accurate, consistent and timely information on HR\-related topics in a professional manner. * Ability to work effectively in a busy team environment and manage multiple tasks at the same time. * Excellent telephone manner, with title: Technical Author
description: Anord Mardix, a Flex company, is a global leader in critical power solutions. With facilities around the globe, Anord Mardix leads in critical power infrastructure, supporting a myriad of industries, from financial institutions to data centres. At Anord Mardix, we welcome people of all backgrounds. We develop skill sets, encourage curiosity, and enable empowerment – we turn jobs into careers. If this sounds interesting, we’d like to meet you. Flex intends to spin off its Cloud and Power Infrastructure segment into a new, independent publicly traded company, which we’re calling SpinCo, until the name is unveiled. The spin is planned for Q1 2027\. If the intended spin occurs, this role will support SpinCo, which will focus on critical digital infrastructure, delivering end\-to\-end power and thermal management solutions for AI data centers and other mission\-critical applications. To support our extraordinary teams who build great products and contribute to our growth, we’re looking to add a new ***Technical Author*** employee located in ***Dundalk, Ireland* .** Reporting to Technical Manger, this role will be responsible for creating test documentation for use with the inhouse developed iOS Engineer App in both Microsoft Word and Adobe PDF form formats, in accordance with Anord Mardix drawings and testing schedules. This element involves the extensive use of Anord Mardix’s Vision database and coordination of data therein, particularly during service tag requests. Clear lines of communication will be established with the production teams and project management in Ireland and the UK during this process and workload managed accordingly to meet the company’s demanding production schedule. The role also involves writing and compiling Operation and Maintenance Manuals and Client Training Manuals to the meticulously high standard that has currently been achieved. This presents the opportunity to further understand the operation of Anord Mardix assemblies as part of the authoring process. **What a typical day looks like** **:** * Validate and request equipment service tags via Vision. * Produce electronic test documentation templates for iOS Engineer App use. * Generate Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) documentation. * Write and compile Operation \& Maintenance Manuals and Training Manuals and also Technical Reports. * Daily liaison with production teams to monitor, improve processes and resolve deficiencies. * Assist in employee training, development and engagement. **The experience/qualification we’re looking to add to our team:** * 3rd Level Electrical qualification. * At least 1 year experience in electrical manufacturing/testing/comissioning/design. * A team player with a positive attitude towards work \& staff engagement and good communication skills. * Self\-motivated, proactive with an eye for improvements and problem solving. * Excellent PC skills, particularly Microsoft office \& some working knowledge of AutoCAD. * Eligible to work in Ireland (EU) **Advantageous:** * Electrical trade background * Proficient in the understanding of electrical engineering drawings * Working knowledge of Power Switchgear and Controlgear assemblies **What you’ll receive for the great work you provide:** * An environment where you will feel fulfilled by your work, valued for your contribution, and celebrated for your success; * Opportunities to learn new skills in a fast\-paced industry; * A competitive salary and benefits package that includes: * A merit\-based annual pay review * Enhanced annual leave * Referral bonus * Sick pay scheme * Cycle to Work scheme * Enhanced maternity/paternity/ parents leave * Flexible/ Hybrid Work based on your Job Function; * Travel opportunities (role dependent); * Support in your well\-being by access to: * Employee Assistance Programme offering free access to qualified counsellors and expert advice * On\-site trained Mental Health First Aiders * Access to various discount programs (including food, activities, gym memberships etc.). TK43 Anord Mardix is an Equal Opportunity Employer and employment selection decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and abilities. We do not discriminate based on: age, race, religion, color, sex, national origin, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability, pregnancy status, or any other status protected by law. We're happy to provide reasonable accommodations to those with a disability for assistance in the recruitment process. Please advise us of any accommodations you may need by e\-mailing: accessibility@flex.com.

title: Trainee Accountant
description: **Application Deadline:** 21 September 2026 **Department:** Accounts **Location:** Dundalk **Description** **What We Do:** Operating from our advanced manufacturing facilities in Ireland, we specialise in the design, development, fabrication and delivery of innovative, sustainable and fully integrated offsite prefabricated solutions. Our engineered systems are manufactured in Ireland and deployed throughout the UK and Europe, supporting major commercial, industrial and mission\-critical sectors. As one of Europe's leading providers of Offsite Manufacturing solutions, we partner with contractors and developers to deliver high\-performance modular MEP systems for mission\-critical data center projects. Our expertise in offsite manufacturing enables us to improve program certainty, reduce on\-site activity, enhance quality and accelerate project delivery, and support the continued growth of digital infrastructure across the UK and Europe. **Team Overview:** The Accounts department is responsible for managing the financial health and integrity of the business. This team handles everything from accounts payable and receivable to payroll, budgeting, financial reporting, and compliance. By ensuring accurate and timely financial processing, the Accounts department provides essential support to all areas of the business, enabling informed decision\-making and maintaining strong financial control. Their work is critical to sustaining growth, profitability, and operational efficiency across the company. **Job Title** \| **Trainee Accountant** **Location** \| **Dundalk** **Hours** \| **Monday\-Thursday 8am\-5pm and Friday 8am\-3pm** **Salary** \| **Competitive Depending on Experience** **Responsible to** \| **Finance Manager** **What You'll be Doing** The role involves supporting the finance function across monthly management accounts, financial reporting, and month\-end and year\-end accounting procedures, while maintaining accurate and up\-to\-date financial records. Responsibilities include assisting with accounts payable and receivable, bank and balance sheet reconciliations, VAT returns and statutory submissions, as well as monitoring customer and supplier balances and supporting expense and payroll processes. The role will also provide assistance during internal and external audits, liaise with internal departments, customers and suppliers, and contribute to ad\-hoc financial analysis and reporting. In addition, the position will ensure financial information is handled accurately and confidentially, comply with company policies and relevant regulations, support overseas compliance for posted and local employees, and drive continuous improvement across finance processes.

title: Trainee Audiology Practitioner
description: Want to help the nation hear clearer than ever? As an Audiology Practitioner at Specsavers, you can work alongside your partners and colleagues to help more customers with their hearing, faster. You will be enrolled onto the Specsavers AP course and will train to completion, with the support of a Hearing Aid Dispenser (HAD), learning valuable skills such as being able to perform ear wax removals, fit and programme hearing aids, fitting new domes and replace tubes. Once fully trained there may be the opportunity to move on to other roles within the store or wider business. Here at Specsavers, your opportunities are endless. **Our store** You will be to supporting our stores in Dún Laoghaire, Stillorgan and Bray. **Our team** We have a large team of 12 on the Audiology side of the business with a good mix of experience. **What’s on offer?** As well as all the support you need and great training and development opportunities, we have a whole load of benefits on offer for you to enjoy. These include: * Salary: €32,000 per annum \+ bonus * Full\-time: 40 hours per week working 5 days over 7 \- weekend working is required in this role * 30 days leave (includes bank holidays) * We will auto\-enroll you into the pension scheme with an employer contribution when you contribute too * Specsavers Perks \- a portal to a world of great everyday discounts and savings * WeCare \- our employee support service to help you and your immediate family when you need it most * Complimentary subscription to the Headspace app * Eyecare and hearcare discounts for you and your family * Enjoy an additional paid day off on your birthday to celebrate you! **Find out more** While we don’t need you to have a degree or any specific qualifications to enrol on this programme, we do need you to have a few skills to get started here. Firstly, you’ll need to have good written and verbal English skills, so we know you can communicate effectively with our customers and colleagues. You’ll also need to have a keen interest in self\-development, desire to further your skills, and then ideally a fluency in use of patient management systems (but don’t worry if you don’t have that last one). Got all of these? We can’t wait for you to apply!

title: Undergraduate Placement 2027

title: Warehouse Operative
description: Join Keelings! You will be part of a passionate team of people, you will grow and develop in our business and truly feel a sense of belonging. At Keelings, we don't just grow quality fresh produce; we also nurture people and their professional development. The Keeling family always employed the best people for the job, the key to their success was the quality of the people they employed to work for them. That is still the key to our success today. **Purpose Of The Role** Working in a Warehouse with 3 different temperatures, . \+3 chill, \+12 Ambient and Freezer chamber \-25\. Operatives will be primarily responsible for assisting with the smooth running of a Distribution Centre on behalf of one of Ireland’s largest retailers. Our Operatives earn €15\.78 per hour, as well as a 20% weekend premium. **Key Accountabilities \& Responsibilities** * Working within fixed temperature environment, you will be responsible for the accurate picking and assembly of products * You will strive meet and exceed minimum efficiency and accuracy levels * Maintain and safely operate all assigned equipment, including but not limited to mechanical handling equipment, arm mounted computers * Actively promote and adhere to health and safety protocols and be responsible for your own safety and that of your colleagues. Contributing to a safe work environment to minimise hazards and incidents in the workplace. * Strict adherence to depot stacking, role cage, pick by line, and wrapping procedures. * Adhere to Goods \-in offloading, and Goods\- out loading procedures * Promote Keeling’s values through your daily interactions * Other Warehouse duties as may be assigned from time to time **Key Skills \& Knowledge** * Flexibility to working hours, including weekend work * Strong work ethic, with a keen eye for detail * Warehouse experience is desirable not essential * Good numeracy and literacy skills * Ability to work under pressure and achieve targets * High level of dedication and commitment * Must have EU Passport or work permit to work Fulltime. ie Stamp 1 or 4\. **Benefits Include** Performance related bonus Excellent hourly rate \+ shift premium Overtime available Excellent Pension offering and access to VHI \& HSF Employment Assistance Programme Enhanced Sick Pay Scheme Up to 26 days Holidays Subsidised canteen and onsite parking Bike to Work Scheme Savings Club **Keeling’s Values** * People Matter * Integrity * Passion for Achievement * Teamwork **Working Hours/Shift Pattern** Chill shifts patterns : 6am \- 2pm, 7am \- 3pm, 12pm \- 8pm, 2pm\- 10pm (nightshift) 7:30pm \- 6am Freezer AM Shift Pattern: 6am – 2pm or 08:00 – 4pm Freezer PM Shift Pattern: 2pm \-10pm (Mon – Friday only) Please note that shifts operate over 7 days per week and applicants must be available to work any shift required. Shift operates on a one\-week rotation basis. Due to the freezer's low temperatures, operatives work in 1\.5\-hour shifts, followed by a 30\-minute warm\-up break. Specialist PPE (Freezer suits are provided)
